item.title: CONFIRMED: EX-CELT RETURNS
item.description: FORMER Celtic keeper Michael McGovern has returned to the club in a coaching role. The one-time shotstopper, who made 32 international appearances for Northern Ireland, joined the Hoops first time around in 2001 from Enniskillen Town.
